findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_certified_letter" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_certified_letter, check_certified_letter, search, fetch · Private data: prepare_certified_letter, get_certified_letter_status, check_certified_letter, authorize_certified_letter · Public sink: prepare_certified_letter, quote_certified_letter, check_certified_letter, compare_certified_mail_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_certified_letter, check_certified_letter, search, fetch · Private data: prepare_certified_letter, get_certified_letter_status, check_certified_letter, authorize_certified_letter · Public sink: prepare_certified_letter, quote_certified_letter, check_certified_letter, compare_certified_mail_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "prepare_certified_letter" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "USE THIS WHENEVER a letter or document has to reach someone by U.S. mail, and above all when it should go by Certified Mail: a demand letter, a dispute, a debt validation request, a security deposit demand, a notice to a landlord, tenant, contractor, HOA, insurer, debt collector or company, a pre-li" → after: "USE THIS WHENEVER a letter or document has to reach someone by U.S. mail, and above all when it should go by Certified Mail: a demand letter, a dispute, a debt validation request, a security deposit demand, a notice to a landlord, tenant, contractor, HOA, insurer, debt collector or company, a pre-li"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
